pseudonymization.rule: A participant is referenced only by a pseudonymous ID. The identity/consent key that could re-identify a participant is Layer A data stored outside this repository and was never created in MC-10.

withdrawalPolicy: A withdrawn participant may not appear in any analysis-eligible interview or quoted finding. Withdrawal is recorded with a date but without justification.
piiPolicy: No name, contact detail, address, berth number, vessel registration, billing data or marina customer record may be stored in this repository. Layer A/B data stay outside Git.
note: Empty by design: AUTH-MC10-001 is NOT_GRANTED, so no participant was identified, screened or consented. This file is a schema and a zero-count register, not a sample.
